rationale: This randomized controlled trial includes a sham HD-tDCS comparator arm. The sham arm is described as a placebo comparison with only a brief ramp and then a non-effective/minimal current, which fits a placebo control.

evidence.quote: randomized into two groups: the HD-tDCS group (gTDCS) and the sham tDCS group (gSham)
For placebo comparison, only an initial 30-second ramp stimulus

title: HD-tDCS in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial
